frequency_question: How often does an official strike notice or unresolved industrial dispute by a major umbrella labor federation culminate in an actual indefinite strike within the designated window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide federation strike calls or ballot-backed strike notices in heavily regulated sectors (banking, railways, public utilities); excludes localized or single-enterprise strikes.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association / UFBU call (1997)
Central Trade Unions general strike notice (2016)
UFBU threatened strike settled via conciliation (2023)

coverage_note: 10 prominent cases named spanning 1997-2023; representative of national federation industrial action patterns.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional wildcat actions, focusing strictly on umbrella union federation level strike notices.
skeleton: Total major industry-wide union strike calls issued vs. those resulting in executed strikes in the target sector
multiplier: 7 hits out of 10 enumerated major industry-wide federation dispute escalations
validity_reason: Labor laws and federation bargaining structures in the relevant jurisdiction remain stable over medium-term horizons.
